The '6-12 months' usage suggests they have overcome initial learning curves and found it sufficiently usable for their needs. The frictions would likely stem from adapting a sales-centric tool to a potentially marketing-centric role, or the initial configuration of custom fields and workflows to suit a non-traditional sales process in the design industry."
